column1: The Messenger of Allah said: The best of you are those who have the best manners and character
None of you believes until you wish for your brother what you wish for yourself
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good words or keep silent
The most perfect of the believers in faith are the best of them in character
Wealth and children are adornments of this worldly life but the everlasting good deeds are better
Do not curse anyone or anything for perhaps it may be in their best interest
The best people are those who bring most benefits to the rest of mankind
Forgive him who wrongs you attack him who does good to you
Whoever is patient Allah will increase their reward
The strong person is not the one who overcomes others by force but the one who controls themselves
